tailoring.headline: Java Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris). Experienced in developing OCC REST APIs, microservices, database query optimization, and data integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Proven track record at Rockwell Automation and Shell within agile teams, holding the SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer certification.
keywords_missing: specific project management methodologies unique to hmmh

cover_en.subject: Application: Java Developer | SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Java Developer | SAP Commerce position at hmmh. With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and backend developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in building and extending enterprise e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators and Converters.

bullets.label: Platform Operations & Maintenance
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and managed platforms through the Hybris Admin Console and Backoffice.

bullets.label: Performance & Quality
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, supported by automated unit testing with JUnit.

cover_en.gap: While I have built extensive e-commerce solutions, I am keen to learn any proprietary internal workflows or specific agency methodologies used at hmmh.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, making me available to start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my background in an interview.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Java Developer | SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit großem Interesse habe ich Ihre Ausschreibung für die Position als Java Developer | SAP Commerce bei hmmh gelesen. Als Backend-Entwicklerin mit über 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java und Spring mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java
bullets.text: Entwicklung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement.

bullets.label: APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services (Headless APIs) und Anpassung von Interceptors, Populators und Converters für kundenspezifische Datenflüsse.

bullets.label: Betrieb & CI/CD
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) sowie Plattformverwaltung über die Hybris Admin Console.

bullets.label: Datenbanken & Qualität
bullets.text: Durchführung von Datenbankabfrage-Refatorierungen zur Reduzierung der Latenz und Erhöhung der Transaktionsgeschwindigkeit sowie Erstellung von JUnit-Testsuites.

cover_de.gap: Sollten spezifische unternehmensinterne Tools oder Methoden zum Einsatz kommen, bin ich hochmotiviert, diese kennenzulernen.
cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe und verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Aufenthalts- und Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag im Rahmen meiner Kündigungsfrist ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 verfügbar bin. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at hmmh because of its strong reputation in e-commerce and digital solutions. My 5+ years of hands-on experience building and supporting large-scale enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for international clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell align well with the technical challenges in your projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated SAP Commerce and Java developer with 5+ years of experience in building enterprise e-commerce platforms, seeking to contribute technical skills to hmmh.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Commerce Cloud and Java Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am interested in the Java Developer role at hmmh. I have a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Java Developer | SAP Commerce (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Java Developer | SAP Commerce position at hmmh. 

With over 5 years of experience building enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in OCC APIs, Spring, and platform maintenance. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
